a: शल्यं — [शल्-यत्] 1 A spear, javelin, dart. --2 An arrow, a shaft; शल्यं निखातमुदहारयतामुरस्तः R. 9. 78; शल्यप्रोतं 9. 75; अवगच्छति मूढचेतनः प्रियनाशं हृदि शल्यमर्पितं R. 8. 88, Ś. 6. 8, V. 2. 10. --3 A thorn, splinter. --4 A pin, peg, stake (said to be m. also in these four senses). --5 Any extraneous substance lodged in the body and giving it very great pain; अलातशल्यं U. 3. 35; अपनीताशेषशल्यः Dk. --6 (Fig) Any cause of poignant or heart-rending grief; उद्धृतविषादशल्यः कथयिष्यामि Ś. 7. --7 A bone. --8 Difficulty, distress. --9 Sin, crime --10 Poison. --11 Abuse, defamation. --ल्यः 1 A porcupine, hedge-hog. --2 The thorny shrub. --3 Extraction of splinters. --4 A fence, boundary. --5 The Bilva and Madana trees. --6 A kind of fish. --7 N. of a king of Madra and brother of Mādrī, the second wife of Pāṇḍu, and thus maternal uncle of Nakula and Sahadeva. [In the great war he at first intended to fight on the side of the Pāṇḍavas, but he was artfully won over by Duryodhana and subsequently fought in his behalf. He acted as charioteer to Karṇa when he was generalissimo of the Kaurava forces, and after his death was appointed commander. He maintained the field for one day, but was at last slain by Yudhiṣṭhira]. --Comp. --अरिः an epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira. --आहरणं, --उद्धरणं, --उद्धारः, --क्रिया, --शास्त्रं extraction of thorns or splinters, or that part of surgery which relates to the extraction of extraneous matter from the body. --कंठः a porcupine. --लोमन् n. the quill of a porcupine. --हर्तृ m. a weeder.

शल्य—पर्णिका or शल्य—पर्णी, f. a kind of medicinal plant, Bhpr.

शल्य—पर्वन् n. N. of the ninth book of the Mahā-bhārata, (this book describes how, on the death of Karṇa, Śalya, king of Madra, was appointed to the command of the Kuru army, and how a combat with maces took place between Śalya and Bhīma, and another great battle between Śalya and Yudhiṣṭhira, in which the former was at last killed).
शल्य—प्रोत mfn. pierced or transfixed by an arrow, Ragh.
शल्य—स्रंसन n. the extraction or removal of a thorn, Kauś.
शल्य—तन्त्र n. N. of ch. of medical wk.
शल्य—वारङ्ग n. ‘arrow-handle’, the part by which an arrow or other foreign substance lodged in the body is laid hold of during the operation of extraction, ib.
शल्य—वत् mfn. possessing an arrow, having an arrow-head sticking in it (as a deer), MBh. xii, 4649
or owning the arrow-head (and so owning the animal killed by the arrow), Mn. ix, 44
set with stakes, hampered or harassed with difficulties, W.
शल्यय Nom. P. ˚यति, to pain, torment, injure, Anarghar.

a: शल्यित — a. Pierced(as with a dart); निष्कारणपरित्यागशल्यित U. 3.

m: शल्यो˚द्धार m. N. of wk.
शल्योद्धरण n. N. of wk.
शल्यो˚द्धृति f. the extraction of arrows and thorns &c. (also as N. of wk.)
